errors.evidence: The description invents details about the vertical axis. The figure does not have any visible axis labels, tick marks, or a defined range on the y-axis.
The description incorrectly states that some bars are shaded. All bars are filled with solid colors (light green and light blue), and there is no shading.

errors.text_span: Стълбовете са подредени според категориите на хоризонталната ос в нарастващ ред.
errors.evidence: This statement is ambiguous. The categories on the horizontal axis are ordered by increasing percentage range, but the bars themselves are not ordered by height. The phrasing incorrectly suggests the bars are ordered.
The legend label is "В страната", not "В страна". This is a minor spelling error.
